title: The crosslinkable rubber composition of sulphur
abstract: The present invention relates to a kind of crosslinkable rubber composition of sulphur, Pneumatic vehicle tire, band, belt and flexible pipe are particularly used for, feature of the mixture in addition to other business is improved rolling resistance behavior.For this purpose, the rubber composition contains at least following component：5phr to 95phr at least one styrene butadiene ribber, at least one styrene butadiene ribber is functionalized with phthalocyanine moieties and/or hydroxyl and/or epoxide group and/or silane vulcanized thing group, and its styrene-content is 0wt% to 12wt% and it has 75 DEG C to 120 DEG C of glass transition temperature (T under unvulcanized state according to DSC g ), 5phr to 95phr at least one other rubber, and 20phr to 300phr at least one silicic acid.
